title: SM AC4C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine AC4C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} sets the regulator gain, {Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the regulator output, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the regulator output, {Voltage regulator input (voltage error) maximum limit, V_Imax (pu)} sets the maximum limit of the voltage error, {Voltage regulator input (voltage error) minimum limit, V_Imin (pu)} sets the minimum limit of the voltage error, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location and {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}. Values come from the instance.
